EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows typical aliphatic C–H stretches at 2877/2936/2980 cm⁻¹ and a CH2 scissoring band at 1462 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), plus a cluster of strong bands at 1125, 1087, and 1048 cm⁻¹ consistent with multiple C–O–C stretching modes of an ether (C–C/C–O region per GFQ-010). Additional bands at 892 and 834 cm⁻¹ fit C–O–C deformation/rocking seen in open-chain ethers. No clear O–H stretch is evident, disfavoring alcohol-containing candidates. Among candidates lacking O–H, #3 is a dialkyl ether and best matches the observed ether-specific band pattern.
